name: signalKit
description: A deterministic, re-entrant pure-Lua signal primitive, with named message buses and journals as optional parts, for MoltenCodes runtime packages.
summary: Deterministic, re-entrant callback dispatch with explicit connection lifetimes and subscriber-transition hooks; message buses and journals as parts.

Bus.description: Named message buses: topics and their argument policies, Publish and Subscribe, bus scopes, ForAddon with the close of an addon's bus at logout, and isolated delivery.

Journal.description: NewJournal: a signal that records its last firings for explicit pull.

Coalescing.description: Bucketed bus messages: collect a burst of publishes and deliver it once per interval.
